newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.
newsitem.headline: Singapore rubber futures close lower across board.

text.p: Rubber futures closed lower across the board on Monday on some late selling interest with activity limited by the closure of the Japanese markets due to a holiday there, dealers said.
"The market was quiet and featureless today. It was practically dead, no incentives at all and the closure of the markets in Tokyo and Kobe helped to pull prices down,"a local broker said.
"There was no reason to trade today. Japanese markets were closed today and most people were sitting on the sidelines, hesitant to open or hold new positions," another broker said.
At around 0945 GMT, December RSS3 fell one cent to 128.50 U.S. cents a kg.
December RSS1 fell 1.75 cents to 183.75 Singapore cents (US$1.31) a kg.
December TSR20 eased half a cent to 178.75 Singapore cents (US$1.27) a kg.
